title: Nested GraphQL fields that return per-model resources must be listed in PROTECTED_NESTED_FIELDS, not only top-level names
answers: nested modelVersions visible on a run without model permission
GraphQL run model versions leak registered model metadata
why does mlflowGetRun or mlflowSearchRuns show models I cannot read
add auth check to a nested GraphQL field in basic-auth
body:
Symptom: a user with READ on an experiment sees name, version, source, tags and aliases of registered models they hold no grant on, under a run in the UI or GraphQL, while REST search and mlflowSearchModelVersions hide them.
Root cause: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:GraphQLAuthorizationMiddleware.resolve matched only info.field_name against PROTECTED_FIELDS, so nested run.modelVersions (MlflowRunExtension) passed through unauthenticated and unfiltered.
Fix pattern: register nested fields as (parent GraphQL type name, field name) in GraphQLAuthorizationMiddleware.PROTECTED_NESTED_FIELDS; gate resolve() on (info.parent_type.name, field_name); and filter the result in _post_resolve with the same predicate the top-level search uses.
Constraints: key by parent type, because a bare field name also matches same-named sub-fields such as MlflowSearchModelVersionsResponse.modelVersions, which are already filtered and would be filtered twice. _post_resolve matches the bare name only because resolve() has already gated it.
Applies: any GraphQL field returning a per-object-permissioned resource that is also reachable through another protected query.
applies: basic-auth GraphQL middleware in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, for any nested field returning permissioned resources.
says: Users without model permissions can see restricted registered models under an experiment run.
Viewing an experiment run leaks tags and aliases of unauthorized registered model versions.
Hide restricted model versions when users inspect runs in an authorized experiment.
Experiment run details screen displays registered models that the current user cannot access.
Prevent unauthorized registered model metadata from appearing in run overview screens.
search: In basic-auth GraphQL authorization middleware in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, nested fields returning permissioned resources like run.modelVersions must be registered as (parent GraphQL type name, field name) tuples in GraphQLAuthorizationMiddleware.PROTECTED_NESTED_FIELDS. Authorization gates resolve() on (info.parent_type.name, field_name) to prevent unauthenticated access to registered model metadata under runs. The result is filtered in _post_resolve using the same predicate as top-level search. Keying by parent type prevents double-filtering on same-named sub-fields like MlflowSearchModelVersionsResponse.modelVersions.
